$comment: Contract vectors for @intellectif/lk-practice (criteria 11, 12 and 16), generated by scripts/contracts-vectors.mjs and run by vectors/replay.mjs. `decompose` runs decompositionRequest, checkDecomposition, admitExtension and composeGraph, then (with `steps`) a record against the composed graph and a full replay. `generate` runs `steps` through createPractice(config), plans `request`, then runs generationRequest for the target of `targetSkill` (with the fields of `target` over it, under `requestConfig` when given), checkCandidates, admitCandidate for each proof with a record of each admitted item, and a record of each accepted candidate stored without a proof. `grade` runs checkGradeResult over `rows` and evidenceFromGrade over `evidence`. `outcome` (M10) runs evidenceFromOutcome over `evidence`, whose outcomes lk-core made where it makes them, and skillOutcomesFromCriteria over `criteria`. `diagnose` (M12) runs `steps`, prerequisiteRequest for `diagnosis` and checkPrerequisiteHypothesis of `proposal`; with `open`, it opens that accepted hypothesis and plays `rounds`, each a plan answered by the first skill of its targets, admitting each confirmation with discoveryExtension and composeGraph and replaying the log, with prerequisiteVerdict and prerequisiteReport after each round; then `close`, `again` (a second proposal) and a final replay. A call that throws is recorded as its error name. Floats compare at a relative 1e-9; integers, strings, null and every time exactly.
